info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Retail Orders Cancel-v4-spec
info.description: The Cancel Retail Orders API allows businesses to efficiently manage the cancellation of retail orders. This endpoint provides the functionality to cancel existing orders, ensuring accuracy in order processing and inventory management. It is typically used by e-commerce platforms or retail systems needing to handle customer requests for cancellations. By utilizing this API, developers can streamline order modifications, enhance customer satisfaction, and maintain operational integrity.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel an order that you have created. Provide the order ID and the system will process your cancellation request, ensuring the order is no longer active.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel an existing order. Ensure that the request contains all necessary fields specified in the schema to successfully process the cancellation.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelRequest.description: A request body schema indicating a cancellation operation for an order.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelResponse_202.title: Order Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the order being cancelled.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the order after the cancellation operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation result.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelResponse_202.description: Response schema for a successful order cancellation operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that initiated the cancellation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the cancellation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information regarding the audit log for the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the processing time for the delete operation, useful for performance monitoring.

schema.description: The total time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
